extension.description: Write GoEasyERP extension apps, compile them, and publish them to a local development container.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: The extension builds and publishes the code of the open folder, so the folder must be trusted.
task.compile: compile: build, check and package the app on this computer
launch.server: The address of the development server.
launch.company: The company to log in to.
launch.user: The user who publishes; needs the SUPER role. The password is asked for and kept in the secret storage.
launch.startupPageId: The page the browser opens after a publish.
launch.schemaUpdateMode: synchronize adds new tables and fields. recreate is not available yet.
debugger.label: GoEasyERP
debugger.snippet: Publish the app to a GoEasyERP development server.
